# English ingredient lines and how Mirepoix reads them (R1.5, D9).
#
#   line  =>  quantity | unit | name | note | equivalents | doubts
#
# Trailing empty fields can be left out. Equivalents look like "437 g" or
# "240 ml; 8 fl oz". Doubts are codes separated by spaces. Lines starting with
# # are comments. Add every real-world line that surprised us.

# Plain amounts
2 cups all-purpose flour => 2 | cup | all-purpose flour
1 cup sugar => 1 | cup | sugar
1 tsp baking soda => 1 | tsp | baking soda
1 Tbsp olive oil => 1 | tbsp | olive oil
2 tablespoons butter => 2 | tbsp | butter
3 T sugar => 3 | tbsp | sugar
1 t salt => 1 | tsp | salt
500 g flour => 500 | g | flour
500g flour => 500 | g | flour
1 kg potatoes => 1 | kg | potatoes
8 oz cream cheese => 8 | oz | cream cheese
1 lb ground beef => 1 | lb | ground beef
2 lbs carrots => 2 | lb | carrots
250 ml milk => 250 | ml | milk
1 l water => 1 | l | water
4 fl oz heavy cream => 4 | fl oz | heavy cream
2 fluid ounces lime juice => 2 | fl oz | lime juice
2 cups packed brown sugar => 2 | cup | packed brown sugar

# Things counted, without a unit
2 large eggs => 2 | count | large eggs
3 carrots => 3 | count | carrots
2 bay leaves => 2 | count | bay leaves

# Fractions, decimals and ranges
1/2 cup milk => 1/2 | cup | milk
½ cup milk => 1/2 | cup | milk
1½ cups sugar => 1 1/2 | cup | sugar
1 1/2 cups sugar => 1 1/2 | cup | sugar
1-1/2 cups sugar => 1 1/2 | cup | sugar
1 ¾ cups flour => 1 3/4 | cup | flour
0.5 kg beef => 0.5 | kg | beef
1.50 lb pork shoulder => 1.5 | lb | pork shoulder
1,000 g flour => 1000 | g | flour
2-3 cloves garlic => 2-3 | clove | garlic
2 to 3 tbsp water => 2-3 | tbsp | water
1–2 tsp chili flakes => 1-2 | tsp | chili flakes
1 or 2 limes => 1-2 | count | limes

# Amounts in words
a pinch of salt => 1 | pinch | salt
half a cup of cream => 1/2 | cup | cream
one can chickpeas => 1 | can | chickpeas
about 2 cups broth => 2 | cup | broth | about

# "of" after a unit
2 cups of flour => 2 | cup | flour
3 sprigs of thyme => 3 | sprig | thyme
1 bunch of cilantro => 1 | bunch | cilantro
2 handfuls of spinach => 2 | handful | spinach

# Notes
1 cup butter, softened => 1 | cup | butter | softened
2 onions, finely chopped => 2 | count | onions | finely chopped
1 cup flour, plus more for dusting => 1 | cup | flour | plus more for dusting
salt and pepper, to taste => | | salt and pepper | to taste
salt to taste => | | salt | to taste
flaky salt, for serving => | | flaky salt | for serving
1 tbsp sugar (optional) => 1 | tbsp | sugar | optional
2 eggs (about 100 g) => 2 | count | eggs | about 100 g
fresh parsley => | | fresh parsley

# Equivalents
2 cups (437 g) unsalted butter, softened => 2 | cup | unsalted butter | softened | 437 g
1 cup (227 g) butter => 1 | cup | butter | | 227 g
1 stick (113 g) butter => 1 | stick | butter | | 113 g
1 (14 oz) can diced tomatoes => 1 | can | diced tomatoes | | 14 oz
1 can (400 g) chickpeas => 1 | can | chickpeas | | 400 g
2 1/4 cups flour (280 g) => 2 1/4 | cup | flour | | 280 g
1 cup (240 ml; 8 fl oz) milk => 1 | cup | milk | | 240 ml; 8 fl oz

# Bullets and checkboxes pasted from websites
- 2 eggs => 2 | count | eggs
• 1 cup rice => 1 | cup | rice
▢ 1 tsp vanilla extract => 1 | tsp | vanilla extract

# Written explicitly: quantity | unit | name
2 | handful | basil leaves => 2 | handful | basil leaves
1 | knob | butter => 1 | knob | butter
| | ice, for serving => | | ice | for serving
2 | cups | flour (250 g) => 2 | cup | flour | | 250 g

# Doubts: kept as read, and flagged
2 knobs of butter => 2 | knobs | butter | | | unknown-unit
2 cups => 2 | cup | | | | no-name
pinch of salt => 1 | pinch | salt | | | assumed-quantity
1/4 cup + 2 tbsp sugar => 1/4 | cup | + 2 tbsp sugar | | | unclear-quantity
2 15-oz cans black beans => 2 | count | 15-oz cans black beans | | | unclear-quantity
2 | cups => 2 | cup | | | | no-name unclear-override

# Numbers written as words (R1.16)
two eggs => 2 | count | eggs
Two large onions, diced => 2 | count | large onions | diced
one cup milk => 1 | cup | milk
twelve sprigs of thyme => 12 | sprig | thyme
twenty-five almonds => 25 | count | almonds
twenty five almonds => 25 | count | almonds
two or three cloves garlic => 2-3 | clove | garlic
three to four tbsp water => 3-4 | tbsp | water
one and a half cups flour => 1 1/2 | cup | flour
a quarter cup oil => 1/4 | cup | oil
three quarters of a cup sugar => 3/4 | cup | sugar
three-quarters cup sugar => 3/4 | cup | sugar
two thirds cup milk => 2/3 | cup | milk
half an onion => 1/2 | count | onion
two dozen eggs => 2 | dozen | eggs
five-spice powder, to taste => | | five-spice powder | to taste
